in_sanskrit.name: शङ्कर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One whose mind is pure, free of all obstacles, and whose essence is that of a god.

in_tamil.name: ஶங்கர
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is free from all impurities and defects.

in_telugu.name: శంకర
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who is a God in the form of a pure mind.

in_marathi.name: Shankara
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Shiva
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shankara हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who consoles or gives peace, Lord of Shiva

in_bengali.name: Shankara
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Shiva
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shankara একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who consoles or gives peace, Lord of Shiva
